name: vbcc-amiga
description: Integrates vbcc/vasm/vlink and Amiga NDK with VS Code C/C++ IntelliSense.

vbccAmiga.vbccRoot.description: Absolute path to the VBCC root directory. When unset, defaults to $VBCC if defined; otherwise /opt/amiga/vbcc on Linux/macOS or C:\vbcc on Windows.

vbccAmiga.ndkPath.description: Absolute path to the Amiga NDK root directory.

vbccAmiga.vbccConfig.description: vbcc profile name (for example, aos68k), passed as +config. Also used to infer vbccAmiga.vbccTarget when vbccTarget is unset. Special case: newlib resolves include/lib paths from VBCC/newlib instead of targets/<target>.

vbccAmiga.vbccTarget.description: vbcc target directory name under targets/<target>. When unset, inferred from vbccAmiga.vbccConfig (aos68k* -> m68k-amigaos, aosppc -> ppc-amigaos, kick13* -> m68k-kick13, morphos|powerup|warpos -> ppc-<config>).

vbccAmiga.intelliSenseMode.description: IntelliSense mode to report to C/C++.

vbccAmiga.cStandard.description: C language standard for IntelliSense (vbcc supports C89/C99).

vbccAmiga.extraIncludePaths.description: Additional include paths appended to the IntelliSense configuration.

vbccAmiga.extraDefines.description: Additional preprocessor defines appended to the IntelliSense configuration.
